requirements.reason: All release build steps execute inside the same-repository reusable workflow; the caller only verifies and publishes the result.
GitHub signs the provenance from its control plane inside the reusable build workflow; signing material is unavailable to user build steps.
The build runs on a GitHub-hosted ephemeral runner inside a reusable-workflow boundary. SLSA v1.2 does not require a hermetic network-free build.
The release builder disables setup/pip caches and installs validators with --no-cache-dir; reproducible artifacts are rebuilt and compared.
The release bundle and GitHub attestations are distributed together and every publish job verifies them before release.
Consumers pin the reusable builder workflow identity, source ref/digest, predicate type and hosted-runner constraint.

claim_rule: A Build L3 VSA may be emitted only while every readiness requirement is satisfied and the caller plus reusable workflow identities are verified.
